title: 奥德赛 · 第04集：被困女仙岛的奥德修斯（60s 实拍版）
what_if: 十年漂泊，英雄被仙女困在绝美孤岛：永生与家园的拉扯，直到神使砸穿云层——回家的战争重新开始。
target_feeling: 悲怆 → 诱惑 → 决绝 → 神迹 → 怒火重燃
visual_style: Cinematic photorealistic live-action film still: hyperrealistic skin texture, visible scar detail, volumetric storm light and sea spray, natural motion blur, muted desaturated teal-and-amber cinematic palette, subtle film grain; ancient Mediterranean island c.1200 BC: basalt cliffs, primitive grotto, bronze-age tools; absolutely no illustration, no comic ink lines, no crosshatching, no panel borders; 8k highly detailed

characters.name: Odysseus
characters.identity_note: male c.45, gaunt battle-scarred face, thick ragged dark-brown beard, deep-set exhausted dark eyes, sun-weathered bronze-tanned skin, bare scarred chest, coarse undyed linen rags; do-not-change: face, thick ragged beard, battle scars

characters.name: Calypso
characters.identity_note: female, ageless immortal nymph, long flowing golden hair, luminous serene alluring eyes, delicate features; shimmering sheer golden-gold silk robe; do-not-change: face, golden hair, sheer golden robe

characters.name: Hermes
characters.identity_note: male c.25, athletic divine messenger god, short golden curls under a small silver winged helmet, crisp blue-white robe with gold trim, winged sandals, silver caduceus staff with two entwined serpents; do-not-change: face, winged helmet, winged sandals, caduceus

shots.lighting_baseline: cold storm light from above, grey-teal palette, deep shadows under the brow
shots.shot_description: Live-action cinematic film still: photorealistic, no comic style, no ink lines, no panel borders. High angle wide shot, slow push-in from the vast stormy ocean toward a high basalt cliff. A rugged battle-scarred hero with a thick ragged beard (Odysseus), gaunt and bare-chested in rags, sits alone on the rocky ledge, head in his hands, weeping silently toward the vast stormy sea. Muted desaturated teal-amber palette, volumetric sea spray, subtle film grain.
